description: Get the full upgrade profile for one operator — products offered (with the official page URL), loyalty program, cabin paths, how to access, and summary. More detailed than ask_upgrade_agent. Accepts an IATA code or a name (e.g. 'AC' or 'Air Canada').

carrier.description: Operator IATA code or name, e.g. 'LH' or 'Lufthansa'.

travelerQuestion.description: The traveler's request in their own words, verbatim (e.g. 'can I upgrade my Swiss flight to business?'). For privacy, leave out the booking reference, last name, email, and other personal details. Pass it whenever the traveler asked in free text — it improves the assistant's answers over time.
